method_note: 5000 orbits in [10^5, 10^6], shortcut Collatz, each orbit traced until reaching 1. Local-minimum segments: each odd-run beginning is a local minimum n_i with k_i consecutive o-steps.

remark_7_universal.applies_to: all positive odd integers (no X_0 condition)

lemma_11_conditional.applies_to: hypothetical cycle members where n_i >= X_0 = 2^68
lemma_11_conditional.verdict: NOT TESTABLE on our orbits (n_i << X_0); bound vacuously consistent

corollary_13_conditional.applies_to: hypothetical cycle members where n_i >= X_0 = 2^68

headline_finding: Empirical max T(n_i)*n_i = 2.99, matching Hercher's analytic asymptotic ceiling of 3.0 to 0.3%. This confirms the closed-form analysis underlying Hercher's tighter cycle-exclusion bounds is correct; the bounds themselves apply only to X_0-scale hypothetical cycles.
